title: Let Sangat sweeten what turned bitter
summary: The prayer asks to meet the Holy Guru so the Shabad can be tasted, and Sangat turns bitterness sweet. Let grace move you toward company instead of another private self-review.
takeaway: Bring the bitter place into Sangat and let the Shabad sweeten it.
lifeApplication: When shame starts rehearsing your failures, do not stay alone with the taste. Read one line aloud, seek one truthful holy companion, and let the next word come from sweetness instead of defense.

source.shortMeaning: The prayer asks for union with the Holy Guru, where the Shabad is tasted and Sangat turns bitterness sweet.
source.lifeApplication: Bring the bitter part of the day toward Gurbani and holy company before judging whether you are changed.

evidence.coreClaim: The bitter heart is not argued into sweetness; it is brought to the Guru, the Shabad, and Sangat until mercy changes its taste.
evidence.turn: Move the bitter place out of isolation and toward the Guru-shaped company where sweetness can be received.
evidence.practicalImplication: When shame starts rehearsing your failures, do not stay alone with the taste. Read one line aloud, seek one truthful holy companion, and let the next word come from sweetness instead of defense.
